name: Create Dev Build APKs
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  buildAPKs:
    name: build APKs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: mobile
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Uninstall `@sentry/react-native` dependency
        run: |
          pnpm uninstall @sentry/react-native
          pnpm sync:licenses

      - name: Set applicationIdSuffix to ".dev" for release build
        run: |
          sed -i 's/signingConfig signingConfigs\.release/signingConfig signingConfigs.release\n            applicationIdSuffix ".dev"/' android/app/build.gradle

      - name: Set app name to "Music (Dev)"
        run: |
          sed -i 's|<string name="app_name" translatable="false">Music</string>|<string name="app_name" translatable="false">Music (Dev)</string>|' android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml

      - name: Clean generated builds
        run: rm -rf android/app/build/generated/

      - name: Build APKs with Gradle
        run: cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease

      - name: Upload APKs as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: outputAPKs
          path: mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
